scenes.headline: How Desert Ant Labs fits models on a phone
scenes.sub: Seventeen single-task on-device models, and where each one came from
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Maple! Desert Ant Labs launched seventeen tiny models that each do one job, on your phone. Here's how they're built.

scenes.text: One task, one small checkpoint, on the device. Of nine models traced, eight adapt existing open checkpoints; one was built from scratch.
scenes.say: One task, one small checkpoint, on the device. Of nine models traced, eight adapt someone else's; one was built from scratch.

scenes.title: Four ways to a small model

items.say: The transcription model converts NVIDIA's Parakeet to Core ML and compresses it; weights otherwise unchanged.
Title fine-tunes IBM's Granite, three hundred fifty million parameters, and ships it at six bits.

items.text: New heads on a shared trunk
items.say: Clips reuses a whole XLM-R encoder and trains four new heads on top.
Only Tongue, a language detector, reads as trained from scratch.

steps.say: Text first meets a Unicode script router with zero parameters.
For twenty-five of its eighty-four languages, the script alone decides.
Otherwise, character n-grams are hashed straight into an int8 embedding table. No tokenizer, no vocabulary file, no encoder.
That covers the other fifty-nine languages, in about two megabytes.

scenes.title: Where a size gap comes from
scenes.say: Where does a size gap come from?

parts.say: Redact, the PII filter, is eleven point six megabytes. Its rival is two point three gigabytes.
About twenty-five times is parameters: twenty-three million against five hundred seventy million.
The other eight times is precision: four-bit weights against thirty-two-bit floats.

left.title: Matched benchmark published
left.say: Where a matched benchmark exists, the trade holds: far smaller, and a few points apart in quality.

right.title: No quality score yet
items: Clips vs Claude Sonnet: still in internal testing
Clear vs Dolby: no PESQ, STOI or DNSMOS
right.say: The two most quoted claims, Clips matching Claude Sonnet and Clear beating Dolby, have no published quality score.

scenes.text: In this family, a small model is mostly an existing one, squeezed: fewer parameters, fewer bits, one job.
scenes.mark: fewer parameters, fewer bits, one job

recap: Eight of nine traced adapt open checkpoints
Tongue hashes n-grams into a 2MB table
A size gap is parameters times precision
scenes.say: To recap: borrowed trunks squeezed hard, one model built from scratch, and quality numbers where they were published.
